description: Recreation of Bernie Hutchins's Vocal Animator: four bandpass filters at vocal formant frequencies, three swept by a bank of slow triangle LFOs, which morphs a rich input into vocal tones

params.text: Sets the speed of all four internal LFOs at once, keeping the ratios between them
Sets the resonance of the filters, which sharpens or broadens each formant
Moves the frequencies of the lower three filters, the lowest tracking a volt per octave and the middle two moving less; the top filter stays at 3700Hz
Sets how far the summed LFOs move the filters, the lower filters moving further while the top one stays put
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the LFO jack before it is added to the LFO rate knob
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the Q jack before it is added to the Q knob
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the Fc jack before it is added to the Fc knob
Attenuates and inverts the CV at the Depth jack before it is added to the Depth knob
Adds bass by switching some or all of the filters from bandpass to lowpass
Picks how closely the four LFOs track each other: down keeps them closely correlated, the middle loosens them, and up lets them go their own ways

inputs.text: The audio to be filtered, which suits a harmonically rich source such as a low pulse wave or something distorted
Sets the LFO speed through the trim knob beside it
Sets the resonance through the trim knob beside it
Moves the filter frequencies through the trim knob beside it
Sets the modulation depth through the trim knob beside it

outputs.text: The four bandpass filters summed together; their unmodulated frequencies are 522Hz, 1340Hz, 2570Hz and 3700Hz
One of the internal triangle LFOs, for modulating other modules or as a slow random-looking voltage

notes: one audio input and one filtered output: the module is mono
